args.body:
Dear Customer,

We’ve processed a refund of 120 for the incorrect billing on your account last month. Your plan tier was mistakenly charged at a higher level, and we’ve adjusted it to **BRONZE**, the correct tier for your subscription.

**Refund Details:**
- Amount: 120
- Reason: Overbilling (incorrect tier)
- Status: Processed (sent to your account)

We apologize for the inconvenience. If you notice any discrepancies or require further assistance, reply to this email or contact our support team.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
[Your Company] Support Team
